ja.tagline: 薄くて柔軟、屋内ジム向けの一足

feats.d: 安定性とコントロール、地面との一体感が求められるウエイトやストレングス種目に最適です。

en.tagline: Very thin, flexible sole for indoor gym training
en.intro: Built with a very thin section and micro-traction lugs, the Groundsplay sole has extremely flexible toes for dynamic movement. Whether lifting weights or moving through training circuits, it provides the grip and control needed to maximize performance.

feats.d: Best for weightlifting, strength training and circuit workouts where stability, control and ground connection are essential.
The 4.5 mm sole uses micro-traction lugs for enhanced grip and flexibility.
The outsole compound is developed with a focus on grip and a more sustainable formulation.
Superior sensory feedback for precise control.

A 50/50 wool and synthetic upper improves breathability and reduces odor.

Disperses impact from rocks and debris while keeping ground feel.
Helps limit the entry of dirt and trail elements, and enhances fit around the toes.
Perfect for trail running on mixed terrain and uneven, rocky paths.
Built for users seeking durability and a secure fit on trails.

Reliable traction across wet, rocky and unpredictable surfaces.
Helps keep debris out of the shoe.
A conforming wrap collar that fits the ankle and helps keep foreign material out.
Water may enter through the collar opening if the water level rises above the ankle opening.

en.tagline: A minimalist outdoor shoe for wet and variable terrain
en.intro: Spidrwalk is developed with a focus on traction, water management and natural movement. The 3.7 mm Vibram Megagrip outsole is engineered for grip across wet and irregular terrain, including rocks, mud and riverbeds.

feats.d: Engineered for grip on rocks, mud and riverbeds.
Let water flow out and support faster drying.
The breathable upper helps limit the entry of sand, silt and small debris.
Suitable for use across water and land, with smooth transitions between environments.
Intended for creek hiking, stream crossings and coastal exploration.

en.tagline: The most breathable model in the FiveFingers collection
en.intro: Breezandal is a breathable minimalist shoe for outdoor use in warm conditions, combining lightweight construction with airflow-focused comfort. Its 5.7 mm sole with Vibram Megagrip compound is engineered for traction on dry and wet surfaces, including areas near rivers and lakes.

feats.d: A protective layer that disperses impact from small sharp objects while keeping ground feel.
Engineered for traction on both dry and wet surfaces.
Enhances ventilation and gives a secure fit.
An adjustable heel strap and webbing system allow a customizable fit.
An abrasion-resistant film layer adds durability in high-wear areas.
